BillHeading.BriefDescription: Extending the effective date of licensing living accommodations for residential private schools.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to extending the effective date of licensing living accommodations for residential private schools; amending 2023 c 441 s 8 (uncodified); and declaring an emergency.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. 2023 c 441 s 8 (uncodified) is amended to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Sections 2 and 4 of this act take effect July 1, 2025 2026.

BillSectionHeader.P: This act is necessary for the immediate preservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of the state government and its existing public institutions, and takes effect immediately.
